game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Oasis Pool, a blue oasis pool: the caravan guide must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Refactor Rescue: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior.
theme: Sand Dunes – Oasis Pool: a blue oasis pool
core_gameplay_loop: In Oasis Pool, repeat each round: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the clean_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the temple door using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The temple door reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the temple door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Refactor Rescue
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Refactor Rescue' (Week 9 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Oasis Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Oasis Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The temple door reached with actions_used <= 13.
